comment: The type of professor you'd grab a beer with. Great guy, very knowledgable, passionate, engaging, and fun.

Knows a lot about the topic but probably has stopped caring. During class goes over basic problems but the tests are really challenging and a lot of it is stuff he barely touched on/wasn't talked about in class.

I'm glad Jerry Is a professor at Richmond, because he clearly knows a lot about what he teaches. He does schedule classes on no-class days, which is annoying. He also does not get to know you. He seems to a little burnt on by now.
Very knowledgeable. His teaching style of just talking at the class non-stop does not match his test style of huge memorization requirements. Assumes everyone knows a lot about Investments.

Stevens is the man and a great teacher.  It is not an easy class, but it is very manageable and you can get an A if you put the effort into it.  I did well and really liked him.  Top prof. in the Bschool!
Best Professor in the B School. He wants all his students to learn and understand the material. He is also very understanding and friendly as a person.
Wants you to learn, but does expect too much. Prepare to devote a good 10 hours per week outside of class if you want an A.
i took his markets class this past summer. good class.

Great professor.  Tough class but possible to get an A. Very understanding...even moved back a take-home quiz when people were confused about a few problems.  Emphasis is on learning as much as possible efficiently...no busy work at all. Take him if you want to learn but not to just get by.
